description: A record of a procedure submission (ADR-2605312030 §3, `toritsugi_submit`). Two `mode`s: `member-self-submit` (default, R2 — toritsugi assembled + handed back, the member filed + signed) and `agent-on-behalf` (代行, R3 GATED — toritsugi filed the member's OWN procedure via the official channel). CONSTITUTIONAL: `agent-on-behalf` is permitted ONLY when the procedure is `council-verified` (G14), per-submission consent is recorded, and the R3 gate (行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+) is satisfied (G15); the only external mutation is a lawful submission via an official channel with member authorization (G10); member is the named 申請者本人 (G4); no platform-held signing key (ADR-2605231525). Holds submission metadata + pointers, never inline PII (G6).

draftRef.description: AT-URI / rkey of the applicationDraft submitted

mode.description: G15 — `member-self-submit` is the default; `agent-on-behalf` (代行) is the GATED R3 exception (council-verified procedure + per-submission consent + 行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+)

consentRef.description: Per-submission consent artifact (G3; mandatory for agent-on-behalf, G15)

councilGateRef.description: For mode=agent-on-behalf: reference to the on-chain Council Lv7+ ratification + 行政書士法 clearance gate (G15). Absent ⇒ agent-on-behalf is invalid.

receiptRef.description: Pointer to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding the submission receipt / 受付番号 (G6)
